note: Physical sizes shared by every sample and test. Images are resampled (area averaging, downsampling only) to target_px_per_mm before tracking, so subset_mm and step_mm are the same px everywhere. Effective strain resolution ~ sqrt(window_mm^2 + subset_mm^2).
edge_note: Interior for J/mean, spread and low spot: at least edge_mm.z from the left/right (axial) tine-tip lines and edge_mm.theta from the top/bottom (circumferential) ones. User-set: edit here, or pass --edge-mm Z THETA to peak_j_figure.py / compare_peak_j.py for one run. edge_effects.py reports where the tine-pitch modulation fades against these values.
